description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating command response objects in the context of 'live' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate error responses based on exceptions and Thing IDs, facilitating error handling for command processing.

classes.name: LiveCommandResponseFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating command response objects, particularly error responses, for live commands in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Creates an ErrorResponse wrapping the provided DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Deprecated method to create an ErrorResponse using a Thing ID string and an exception. Converts string to ThingId and calls the other method.
